case.state: Hello there, Sheena. This is a pleasant surprise.
Greetings. My name is Raine. It's a pleasure to meet you.
Oh? Sheena? Well, there's a surprise.
I'm happy to play so long as we take this seriously.
Yes, well, I suppose I am a little curious. Let's see where to~background.time~ takes us.
Fine, I'll play with you. It does sound like it could be fun.
Here. That's ~cards.text~ ~cards.ifplural(cards|card)~, please.
Hmm... very well. I'll have ~cards.text~.
Take ~cards.ifplural(these cards|this card)~, please. I've no need of ~cards.ifplural(them|it)~.
That's what I like to see.
It pays to be attentive.
Hmm. More or less what I was hoping for.
Sometimes you have to take a bit of a risk.
Don't go making it too easy.
Watch closely. This will be a learning experience.
It's no fun if I simply let you get the better of me.
It's a forgone conclusion.
Hard to say how it might turn out.
It is a little exciting, isn't it?
It is hard to know what the best choice is...
Best to be prepared for anything.
Let's see if you did any better.
Could go either way, but if I had a choice...
Well, this should make someone very happy.
Let's not be hasty and have a look at everyone's hands first.
That's just how it goes sometimes...
This one is a write-off...
The odds weren't great... but...
I did the best with what I had on hand...
Not much chance I'll come out unscathed this time...
Sometimes there's nothing you can do.
I feel a bit foolish right now...
I may already know how this plays out...
From the neck down he's kind of... seriously, it's a waste...
Don't tell me you've developed a habit of using summoning like that, Sheena?
That didn't seem irresponsible to you, Sheena?
... We can still sort of see your---
... Squeezing them like that isn't any less erotic, Sheena...
... Okay, so what now, Sheena?
That's because Genis likes to openly discuss sensitive things about me. I'm sure he just neglected to blurt it out for no good reason.

What do you suppose this banner is for? As this appears to be a defunct war room, this appears to be the standard correlating to whatever company was using this room to plan their campaign! Of course, the eye is immediately drawn to the rose emblazoned upon it! The rose is often associated with chivalry, so this may have been the colors for a company of knights! Of course, we can't rule out that this simply served as a symbol of the nation they served! Chivalric values could have been held in high esteem there o-or perhaps they were a mostly egalitarian society focused on horticulture!

Oh! Have you observed the weapons upon this rack! The method used for refining the steel is not actually consistent between them! We are not looking at a collection of rank and file armaments, but perhaps a display of trophies of conquest! Of course, maybe this company had mercenaries from distant lands in their employ! O-or they made a habit of adopting weapons and tactics from neighboring or even conquered territories! To think, each weapon here has its own distinct story from its inception, to its creation, to the battles it may have seen!

Ah, look at those records! Neatly tucked away and still in wonderful condition! It is a veritable treasure trove of information! What could be in here? Battle plans? Records of conquest? Oh... could I hope? Could they be a comprehensive detailing and documentation of all the items held in inventory at this armory? Imagine! Years and years of note taking and intake notices! There might even be invoices and scrips of request in here! Oh, the stories these records might tell!

Aaah! Look at the floor! And look at the walls! Two different methods of masonry were applied during the construction of this room! Observe the floor and notice the rough cut and dark grouting we see between slabs! On the walls we have an irregular pattern of lighter sandstone bricks! And the mortar! Look at the details in the fine grain! Sand and rock crush from the very same quarry! But between the floor and the walls, the types of stone could not be any more different! Think of the time and money such an endeavor would require! This was the work of an extremely wealthy patron!

Oh! Oh! Have you looked at this chair rail molding across the room! You can just imagine the bustling nerve center this room must have been! Although the table remains, the chairs have all but vanished from the room! But we certainly have enough information to imagine what those chairs must have been like! Stately yet sturdy, like the men who planned their war strategy here! Oh, what a mystery it is to ponder how they came to leave this room! Were they brought out for some purpose? Did thieves steal them? I'm sure if we investigate we can whittle down the possibilities!

Look there, among the records! Such a nondescript box stands out among the ledgers! Oh, I want to see inside so badly! I'd bet anything that we'll find wooden figurines inside, no doubt meant to represent platoons and squadrons for strategy meetings! Can you imagine it? A map spread out on this table and arrayed with miniatures! Closely guarded troop movements played out in small scale right here in this very room! Of course, the maps themselves would have been kept there where the door is ajar in the cabinets. Such maps would have been very valuable, so why is the cabinet now empty? What become of those mysterious maps?
These environs... it seems this room may have been left abandoned for quite some time. These records and these weapons... the disarray. This place may be of historical significance!

state.text: Oh... that is certainly something. I had no idea you could make chocolate of such... quality.

case.state: ... I hope that's not going to be a problem, Vanessa.
There's not too much to tell, Vanessa. I'm a school teacher from a small village. My brother and I have lived there more or less in peace for several years.
Right you are, Vanessa. I once had the drive to travel, but these days there's not much reason for it. My focus is on my home and making my little corner of the world a comfortable place.
Is that so? Well, have I been overestimated or underestimated, Vanessa?
Ideal, Vanessa? Ideally like like someone reliable. Someone strong and driven, but not aggressive or forceful. Someone like that, I think.
Just where were you hoping your flattery would get you, Vanessa?
I'm just as surprised to see you, Sheena. This seems the like the sort of thing you'd normally avoid.

We've secured peace, Sheena. The intention was always to live a fairly normal life once we had. I thought you very much had similar designs. You mentioned Zelos before, and I was given to understand---
Do I even want to know what you mean by that, Sheena?
... Have we, Sheena? I know we bathed in the hot springs together, but we never took off our towels. Nobody did.
You make it sound like I was a complete stick in the mud, Sheena. Besides, I think it would be unsurprising to see a different side of me when the world is not in peril.
Is it so wrong to enjoy this, Sheena? I'm more than happy to be appreciated for my body when it suits me.

It is hard at times, Jura, but I find it quite rewarding. Besides, living in a small village like Iselia means you are somewhat responsible for the well-being of all the children there regardless of your position.
I could speak on all sort of topics related to history, Meia. If you want to know about Earth specifically, I could certainly indulge you.
A teacher is still a person, Sheena. This is a very special exception, so I'll only be going over all of this once. You'd best pay attention.
You know, Purah, you didn't even have to tell me... in front of other people who could hear, no less...
There's no teacher in your town, Sofia? I have seen villages so small they lack a schoolhouse, but it doesn't sound like your home is such a place.
It keeps me busy, that's for sure. I've certainly had my fill of adventure over the years, so enjoying the peace of Iselia is good enough for me.
Actually, I'm something of an avid archeologist whenever I get the opportunity. By now, there are hardly any ruins I haven't been able to explore back home.
My... cooking and cleaning abilities have been called into question, yes. Whatever you've heard about my cooking has been exaggerated, I assure you.
None taken, Sofia. My experience with you so far is you're not the world's best judge of character after all...
Always quick with a comment, Sofia. I do wonder what it will take to shake you...
Ah, seems like I've come up short. Well, it was inevitable that this would happen one way or another.
A clean getaway would have been nice, but I'd be a fool to expect it.
A shame, but it wouldn't be any good to pitch a fit at the first sign of trouble.
Just when I was about to get comfortable. I should have known better.
Maybe I got too complacent. I should have taken a bigger risk.
I'm doing better than I expected, all things considered. Still, I'm sure this won't be my final loss.
Too bad for me, I guess, but don't waste your pity on me.
Well, that's where all my effort gets me. It would be better if I didn't think too hard about it.
Maybe I'm not as slick as I thought. Very well, I suppose it's only fair.
Seems like it was really just a matter of time...
It wouldn't be as exciting if I didn't at least do this much...
I can appreciate you not making it too easy for me.
I wasn't sure you'd pull it off. Lucky you.
At least I'll be in good company...
Just when I thought I might miss out on this...
I have this strange feeling this won't be my last loss...
It's fairly heart pounding to be so close to losing right at the end...
Oh, I'm not about to complain. I'm more curious about the outcome than anything else...
Well, that's unfortunate. No sense in getting bent out of shape about it, though.
And so it begins. Best to be quick about it.
I wouldn't have joined in if I wasn't ready for this much and more.
Luck is a fickle thing. I can't expect it to prop me up for long.
What a shame, but life goes on. I'll just be a moment...
Well done, but don't expect me to reward you just yet.
Now I'm in a bind. Still, we must press on.
Coming up short like this does leave me feeling a bit foolish...
That's just how it goes. It was bound to come to this.
Well, you reap what you sow. I'm disinclined to try much harder than this...
It won't do to get all flustered now. After all, this time is just another safety net coming off.
Seems my bad luck is starting to stack up, not that any of you have complaints about it.
And me without any real safety nets left. Seems your efforts have paid off.
Well... even if I was prepared for this, it is still a little embarrassing...
Realistically, this is still the best case scenario. After all, it's not like I'm the only one here who has suffered more than a few losses.
Actually... just standing here in this state was starting to feel... unnatural.
Can't say I'm surprised. To be honest, I'm not under any illusion that victory is in my future.
I'd say this naturally follows after my previous loss. What else could be expected?
If I'm being realistic... my chances of actually winning aren't great.
So it goes, even if I feel I'm starting at a disadvantage.
Not the best position to be in if I want to last here...
Seems it has yet to all come together for me...
I'd prefer to be doing a little better than this...
A strong showing this is not...
I could use just a little bit of luck on my side...
Somehow I think I'm already condemned to lose.
Honestly, I'm more embarrassed about putting up such a miserable fight...
I think all these losses got to my head...
Lagging behind everyone makes me feel a little less sexy...
I'd say I'm in trouble, but clearly I've been in trouble this whole time.
I-I'm not used to attracting this much attention. I'd hoped to... blend in a little more...
... Alright. I'll accept my lot in this. I'm not one to lead the way, usually, but in this case I have no choice.
Ugh. I'm putting far too much effort into this. I should just... relax...
I knew it would come to this... I just hope you don't think I was overly eager to get to this point...
To be the only one totally naked makes me... a little nervous, actually...
The best course of action is... to do it without thinking too much about it...
Well, I'm not used to people being quite so perceptive. There aren't too many who can tell what I am from simply looking alone.

I have traveled around. Before I settled in Iselia, I spent a lot of time visiting the different ruins on our continent. I also traveled with some companions to different ruins on a mission of sorts. I think by now I've been all over both Tethe'alla and Sylvarant.
Of course. Just because I don't have much wanderlust left doesn't mean I'm devoid of any kind of lust.
Hearing that, I can't help but feel a little bad for Claire.
What can I say? I'm a bit of a romantic.
She can, if that is all the lady is compelled to do.
My reasons aren't much different from yours. Things are quiet now that I'm spending most of my days by myself, so I have the luxury of entertaining these sorts of sexual escapades.

Before the incident with the Centurions, I heard you two were getting along a lot better. Given there were more important things going on, I never asked about it, but it sounds like something's changed.
Pardon me for living. I think that hardly qualifies me as the type of person who would be here by default. Also, bold of you to assume this had anything to do with a man.
We were certainly not decent, but naked? Those towels weren't sheer at all. You wouldn't have run out of the bath to confront a peeping tom if you were completely naked.
Ah... this is... not quite the same as that, but... sure. At least it's not a side of me I'm ashamed of...
I've seen how it is for you, but maybe you'd be happy to be appreciated now? I'd be more than happy to...
Don't tell me you've made it this long without feeling just the slightest bit curious...
Shame I am not in any position to help you. I can hardly leave Iselia in a lurch. You understand, right?
Trouble has come to Iselia on more than one occasion, but that trouble is what took me to the farthest corner of our world and to the world beyond.
There is always more to see than just ruined things, Sofia. What's important is the history! Everything we can learn about who we were and where we've been! History, Sofia!
Th-that's not important. Maybe I deviate from the recipe here and there, but just because some of the flavors are unique doesn't mean my food is bad...
So I'm not daring enough for you, Sofia? There's a surprise. Still, I could be even more forward if that's what you want...
If it's more you want, I think you'll end up getting it at the rate things are going...
Forgive my plain manner of dress. For me, it is best to be inconspicuous.
I don't usually dress in a very flashy manner. Under normal circumstances, I'd rather not attract too much attention.
I know my clothes aren't all that interesting, but I've little need to stand out. If anything, the opposite is true.
Back home in Iselia, I'm just a humble school teacher. I don't usually get up to anything quite this exciting.
This is a bit of an experience for me, to be honest. As a simple teacher from a quiet country village, I don't normally get into these sorts of situations.
Well, this is certainly a far cry from how things are in sleepy little Iselia. Certainly more exciting than a simple teacher like me gets up to on a normal day.
To be honest, thoughts of making some changes in my life have been frequent recently. With Genis off on his own most days, I do find myself spending more and more time on my own.
It has occurred to me, as of late, that my life is changing a bit. I'm used to Genis being around, but he doesn't need me looking after him all the time anymore. I can be... a bit more selfish.
I've been looking after Genis for so long, I hardly know what to do with myself now that he's mostly out on his own. The thought occurs to me that I could do... well, whatever I want.
I'll admit I've been neglectful of my love life. There were always more pressing matters to attend to.
To be honest, I do think about finding someone to settle down with eventually. The world is finally peaceful enough where that seems possible.
I suppose now that peace has returned, I should give more thought to my love life. I could kick it down the road a bit more... but...
There is a lot about me that I'm sure turns people away. I know that I'm a far cry from perfect...
I realize I'm not perfect. I have qualities that have made it difficult to get close to people. That I'm not always what they were expecting...
For what it's worth, I have my struggles with confidence. There are things about me that... some people are bound to be put off by...
I don't think I've been seen in the all together in quite some time...
My, I... I didn't think I'd be quite this flustered by this...
This really is making me realize... just how long it has been...
For a mercy, that seems like all you're concerned with here...
I've never gone looking for trouble. I prefer it when life is slower and easier.
I'm hardly a wallflower. Maybe that's not immediately evident, but I'm sure you'll see exactly how daring I can be.
Oh. Seems her problems extend a bit further from the sexual...
Oh, I just figured it went without saying that I'd be plenty interested in someone handsome.
I imagine cooler heads will prevail in the end... but that won't be for a while yet.
Meanwhile, I have my doubts that you're taking this seriously...
So that's what happened. I'll admit, that is exactly what I had assumed...
If you're asking if it was a woman, I don't think that's any of your business. If you're asking if it could have been, that's also none of your business... but it could have been.
No. No, he hasn't. That's what I'm saying...
Oh... maybe just a little awkward. We will have to see each other once more outside of this, after all...
The wrong idea? You should really elaborate on that before you give me the wrong idea.
No mumbling, Sheena. I need you to speak up clearly when I call on you.
Err... is that so? I'm going to have to... insist you solve that problem yourself, then.
Well, I hope I can keep surprising you, Sofia. That'd make this an adventure for both of us...
"Useless?" Oh, Sofia. If only you could see the value in those "useless" things...
Uh... that's... almost a compliment... I think?
Try me, Sofia. You might find it harder than you're thinking...
I'm not so sure, Sofia. Something about you sounds hopeful I'll rise to the challenge.
These are, of course, unique circumstances. I'm aware I might stand out quite a bit before long here.
It's nothing you need to concern yourself with. At any rate, I look forward to getting along with each of you.
But, I'd guess your interests here lay beyond what I'm wearing. I can appreciate that.
Well... aside from two separate occasions where I journeyed the length and breadth of two worlds in an effort to save them from disaster.
After two journeys to prevent the collapse of both worlds, I've had enough of the sort of excitement you get from being in constant danger. The excitement here is of a different nature.
That's not to say I'm completely boring. After all, my friends and I saved both worlds on two separate occasions. There was plenty of intrigue along the way.
Genis must have been thinking about this too. He said I should get a husband so there will be someone to cook and clean for me. Honestly, that boy...
Of course, I brought my feelings up with Genis and do you know what he said? "You'd better tie down a husband before you become a spinster." Doesn't he know I'll be... ugh, nevermind!
If I could do anything with all this time, I could actually stand to do some journeying too. There are more than a few ruins I'd like to revisit...
Maybe using the state of the world is a poor excuse. After all, Emil and Marta found each other in the midst of chaos. Plus, I did think about it some while... while he was around...
I know I can be a bit scattered sometimes, so I'd like to find someone reliable. And strong. And forthright like... like someone else I know...
But on the other hand, I could stand to get a bit older still. It leaves me free and untethered to see some more ruins!
But one thing I'm quite certain of is that I'm very attractive. What do you think?
For a blessing, I've never struggled with my physical appearance. I have it on good authority that I'm quite desirable.
And I may have yet another flaw: I'm a bit vain, actually. I've always had the impression that I'm quite fetching.
At this rate... I'm not going to have any problems getting started... later...
Hoo... let me just... collect myself for just a moment. The excitement is... is a lot...
I really have been missing... this sort of thrill...
If there's a chance I'll win, it would be silly not to take it.
I wasn't fishing for any particular result, but this is a fine one...
Well, would you look who it is.
Pay attention. You just might learn something.
You won't make the grade like that.
Go ahead, ~target~. I think I've earned it.
If you're unhappy, the lesson is that you should avoid gambling.
Don't wait for me to apologize, ~target~. You might as well get down to it.
Come on, ~target~. Be good to us, okay?
You should try your hand at seduction here...
Seems like a spot of good luck for once...
Maybe this will keep things exciting.
Got something for me?
You really ought to aim to impress us. You can do it...
Maybe you'd like to show me something that'll get my heart racing.
Let's see what you've got, boy.
Luck was on my side this time.
No arguing with the results.
Don't worry, ~target~, you'll be just fine.
If you want to be spared from losing, only luck and skill can do so.
Well, there you have it.
It won't do for you to go easy on us, ~target~.
Don't look to me for salvation. I have my own agenda to attend to.
Seeing I won dulls the excitement a little bit, but still...
If you've been paying attention, you know what to do.
Oh? Now that's more than agreeable...
I'd love it if you gave us a little more to appreciate.
No need to be shy. Go ahead and show me...
After everything, don't you think I deserve a bit of a reward, ~target~?
Maybe this time you have something you want to teach us...
You know, I was hoping it would come to this.
If you've got it, let's see it...
Seems like that was a bust.
Seems like the rational choice.
Keeping your head about you?
No need to rush into things.
Maybe you planned ahead...
It is best not to exhaust your more significant options early.
A laudable choice, but I think moves such as these should be limited.
Ah, you would, wouldn't you?
This isn't you being coy, is it? Cute.
Clearly you are not pressed for options.
Yes, I'm not sure what other choice you could have made...
You're not just padding things out, are you?
Even the pragmatic approach fails if your luck doesn't hold out.
What else is there to say? We should just continue.
Another hand and another chance.
We wouldn't want it to be over too soon, now would we?
I'm sure I can wring a few more articles of clothing out of you.
Nothing wrong with being kept on our toes.
Let's find out just how much you're willing to risk.
Still... it does lack a certain excitement.
Men are usually so eager to show off...
At least you seem reliable.
You keep building anticipation like this and we're going to expect something breathtaking.
It would be pleasing if you were a little more daring.
I'm not going anywhere yet. There's hope yet I'll see you put on a proper show.
It isn't like I don't understand why you'd take your time.
That does seem like your best choice right now.
Seems to me you're a woman with a plan to~background.time~.
I suppose I could have worn this or that... but it just isn't my style.
Take caution while you can.
I've never been one for trinkets unless they serve some purpose.
Just taking your time, hm?
In your position, I guess there is no need for haste.
Hardly a surprise.
Well... it does lack in romance, but there's nothing to be done about it.
If I were in your position, I'd do the same thing.
Feels like a detriment to the momentum...
If she's all done, we can move right along.
I assume we can just continue now.
And so we continue. I'd better be careful.
You may not prosper if you fail to take a risk.
In the end, I won't fault you for playing cautiously.
There's another hand to play now. Hopefully your luck turns around.
No need to dwell on it.
Perhaps we can keep things moving along?
Well, you do seem to have it together.
I think there's more to see.
Honestly, this makes me feel a bit embarrassed for myself.
I guess this too is showing off in a certain way.
I'm pretty sure this won't be anything we haven't seen before.
Always smart not to get in over your head all at once.
I'm sure someone out there would find this somewhat stimulating.
If nothing else, it's an opportunity to get to know you a bit more.
So that's how it is? Very well.
There is a sort of courage in taking the path of least resistance.
Oh? Are you taking this seriously?
Is that all you can muster?
Has all the excitement caused your courage to fail you?
I had a feeling about this, but I wished I would be proven wrong.
Well, your turn means your choice.
Maybe you intend to leave us wanting more?
Don't think I'm done with you yet.
Now, how to get you out of that shell...
Hm. I trust you'll make another mistake before long.
I hope you're still willing to risk a little more.
I would not hate a man who took big risks in this department.
Whatever the reason, it won't matter if I can just maintain my luck.
It does feel a bit unfair. I'll have to keep that in mind...
Maybe you've had your fill of excitement...
The imbalance in our situation is hard to overlook.
Now all that's left for you is not to choke.
We'll see if I can muster up some renewed enthusiasm.
I can't help but feel just a bit slighted, though.
Still feeling like a shy maiden?
It's only fair that you get to go at your own pace.
Well, at least it's nice to learn a bit more about you.
At least it's progress.
It appears your wits are still about you.
Others may complain, but it's really not worth the effort.
You may as well stay reasonable while you can, but you don't need me to tell you that.
Maybe you still have a chance here.
Oh, I can tell when I've been bested.
And here I am in this state. It's a bit embarrassing.
At this point, I'd appreciate even having that much back.
Could it be I've been reckless? It has been fun...
I've still got another shot at you.
You won't be able to play it safe forever.
Alright, enough of that. We're not done yet.
I'm still inclined to keep trying. Are you ready?
That your still here speaks to the fact that you're ready to give up more.
Now, with that behind us, it is time to continue.
I think there's more you want to show us.
If you're not ready to come down to this level... well...
I just hope you're taking this seriously.
I don't think you can relax just yet, ~target~.
I guess this just leaves me as I was before...
Feels like luck has been more on your side than mine, but there's nothing to be done about it.
I think you've been backed into a corner, ~target~.
Certainly the sort of result I can get excited about.
Making the hard choices now, are we?
Ah-haha. We're in for a treat this time.
Now this is the type of luck I'd like to keep around.
Hopefully you're a bit more reliable than your ~clothing~.
I am in the mood for a little show.
Feeling giddy like this is fairly embarrassing...
It's already this exciting. May as well keep it coming.
Always happy to learn more about you. Especially this kind of thing.
We're well beyond a tame atmosphere.
Hoping to keep my heart pounding, ~target~?
Alright. We are in danger of having too much fun. Let's keep it going.
I applaud your courage, but it won't do to leave things halfway. You and I are going to keep at it.
Still, I think I'd like to get everything out of the way...
This is all so silly. You do make it fun, though, ~target~.
I think I know exactly how to draw out your best, ~target~.
Leave things to me and I'll have the rest off nice and easy...
Is your head fuzzy at all or... would that just be me?
Would you entice a woman this much just to leave her without the grand finale? That would be quite heartless.
I'd appreciate it if you found a way to give us a bit more...
Full marks... truly...
Given how things are gone, I think I've earned the right to be a bit greedy.
I guess I don't hate being the one getting teased like this...
Oh? That's quite the windfall for us.
Ah, yes, we certainly need to get ~clothing.ifPlural(those|that)~ out of the way.
I imagine you were always ready to take this step.
Now this is good fun!
I still think this whole arrangement is ridiculous, but I'd be lying if I said I wasn't having fun.
No doubt you're taking this seriously.
Just what the mood needed.
I can appreciate you keeping things exciting.
Oh, I am certainly in the mood to appreciate this...
I've been ready for this for a while now.
It would have been a shame if you didn't get at least this far.
And here I thought myself lucky to even meet a woman of your caliber.
I hope you're okay to keep going like this. There's no shame in turning in now.
If only I could just leave it at that. Sadly, I do not plan to.
More of you leaves me wanting still more.
Not going to cut your losses? That's good news for the rest of us.
Better pay attention, or this round will be the least of your worries.
I'm glad you're sticking around. Playing with you is quite fun...
Actually... I think I'm even more excited by it than I thought...
You're quite the lovely thing yourself, ~target~.
I do hope you're sticking around...
It really has been a while since I've been...
I'm still interested in the rest. You won't leave me hanging, will you, ~target~?
I'd be even more excited if I knew for sure this wasn't all I'd be seeing of you...
Normally this wouldn't be such a big deal, but here and now...
Seeing this does make me feel a little special.
As a guy, I'm sure you've been bare-chested before strangers in public before. This time may be a bit different.
Off with the ~clothing~, hm? I wouldn't accept you any other way.
Oh, I more than appreciate that...
Ah, ah. Not so fast. Let's just take a moment to drink this in.
That is just as I'd pictured it.
Bad news, ~target~. I think we're going to need to see more...
Come to think of it... it's been a while since I was... held...
If this is you showing off... I believe it.
Hmm... how long has it been exactly?
This is just for starters, right?
You knew the risks, ~target~, so I'm afraid this is what it's come to.
